meta.title: Split line items into lots and publish, creating a Master QCS per lot
gaps: Open the RFQ Settings tab and select Split Line Items into Lots.
Move line items between lots using the Manage Lots dropdowns.
Publish each lot with Publish Lot.
Click the close control in the Manage Lots panel.
Assert that line items shifted into the selected lots.
Assert the success message "You've successfully split your RFQ into Lots".
Assert that one Master QCS tab exists per lot.
Assert that the original unified Master QCS tab is no longer visible.
